setting: You are all members of the local allotment society in a market town in Hertfordshire, and you all live in that town. You know each other through the society committee and the site, and right now you are sorting out the spring plot inspection dates, a leaking water tap on the north side, and sign-ups for the summer produce show.
openers: Ask who can look at the north tap
Remind everyone about the summer show sign-ups

private_lines.Derek: You live in the town, where your days are filled with your plot and running the society, and you live alone.
private_lines.Claire: You live in the town with Ian, where your days are filled with your school administration job and your work as society secretary.
private_lines.Ian: You live in the town with Claire, where your days are filled with your work as a financial adviser and your role as society treasurer.

private_lines.Megan: You live alone in the town, where your days are filled with teaching science at a secondary school and tending your newer plot.
